name: codex-daydream
description: Turn recent Codex work into a privacy-preserving daily cartoon poster with a clear identity panel.

interface.shortDescription: Make a private cartoon poster from today's work.
interface.longDescription: Read a bounded, locally sanitized slice of today's Codex tasks, turn recognizable work themes into playful visual metaphors, and produce a copy-ready poster prompt with an explicit Codex-day title plus a dedicated creator, date, source, and repository panel.
interface.defaultPrompt: 把我从上次总结以来的 Codex 工作变成一张保护隐私的卡通海报提示词。
